name: DeleteMailFolder
description: Deletes a specified mail folder from a Microsoft 365 mailbox using the Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: Microsoft 365 Credentials
fields.description: The Microsoft 365 credentials used to authenticate and access mailbox data via the Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox from which the folder will be deleted. If left empty, it defaults to the authenticated user's mailbox.

fields.name: FolderId
fields.label: Folder ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the folder to be deleted from the specified mailbox.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Deletion Result
fields.description: The result of the folder deletion, including success or failure status and any error messages.
